title: Ephemeral per-tenant collectors + adaptive trace sampling for VPC/On‑Prem
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: In Dedicated and Private deployments customers run multi-tenant workloads across VPCs and air-gapped on-prem clusters. Current collector topology shares long-lived agent instances across tenants which increases blast radius for misconfigurations, allows cross-tenant metric/trace mixing, and makes tenant-specific sampling and retention expensive. Goals: 1) Introduce ephemeral, per-tenant collector processes that can be scheduled inside customer VPCs or on-prem nodes to provide stronger tenant isolation and guardrails for telemetry. 2) Implement adaptive trace sampling and token-based tenant propagation so we control ingestion cost while preserving high-signal traces for SLO and error debugging. 3) Expose safe controls in Console for tenant-level sampling, retention, and cost alerts. Success criteria: - No cross-tenant trace/metric leakage in staged tests. - End-to-end latency of telemetry ingestion for 95th percentile remains < 500ms for VPC flows. - Per-tenant ingestion cost reduces by >= 18% on average via adaptive sampling for noisy workloads. Scope: design collector lifecycle, sampling policy engine, tenant propagation header, RBAC for Console controls, integration tests and two-phase rollout (canary customers -> general availability).
approach: 1) Collector runtime: build a small ephemeral collector binary (Go) that runs as a per-tenant sidecar or separate pod inside customer network when Private or Dedicated is enabled. Collector will accept only authenticated requests with tenant token and will forward through secure egress to Redwood ingest. 2) Sampling engine: server-side adaptive sampler (configurable window + error-weighting) with local fast-path for tail-sampling decisions to reduce traffic spikes. 3) Trace hooks: add tenant_id propagation to trace context at request ingress points and validate at collector boundary to drop malformed/foreign traces. 4) Console: add 'Tenant Signals' page where operators can set sampling policies per tenant, preview estimated cost delta, and schedule temporary overrides. 5) Rollout: unit + integration tests -> internal dogfood on Dedicated staging -> opt-in canaries for 3 customers -> GA.
acceptance_criteria: Per-tenant collector can be created and destroyed without impacting other tenants' telemetry streams
Adaptive sampler reduces overall trace ingress in noisy scenarios by >= 18% while keeping >95% of error traces
Tenant_id present on >99.9% of ingested traces in test harness where SDK injects header
Console exposes sampling slider and cost estimate per tenant, with audit logs for changes
Security review completed and KMS-backed tenant tokens used for collector auth

notes: Implementation must avoid long-lived API keys in collectors; use short-lived tokens rotated by control plane. Collectors must expose health & metrics (ingest rate, dropped-by-sampling, tenant-id-mismatch) to Console. Consider cost controls: hard-limits per tenant and emergency global sampling fallback.
